god_deepfake.title: GenAI in the Battle of Security: Attacks, Defenses, and the Laws Shaping AI's Future (German OWASP Day 2024)
god_deepfake.author: Niklas Bunzel, Raphael Frick (Fraunhofer SIT)
god_deepfake.words: As technologies advance, they bring new opportunities, but also new threats and challenges, it's crucial to remain skeptical and not blindly trust everything you see or hear. So what you just saw is actually an example of a deep fake.

fed_altman2.title: Fireside Chat with Vice Chair for Supervision Bowman, Integrated Review of the Capital Framework for Large Banks Conference, 22 Jul 2025
fed_altman2.author: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
fed_altman2.words: You say a challenge phrase and they just do it. That is a crazy thing to still be doing. AI has fully defeated that.
